# Steelyes

> Steelyes is a UK steel fabrication and installation company (Enfield, London), specialising in bespoke, made-to-measure steel driveway gates, electric/automatic gate automation, glass balustrades, metal and glass balconies, structural steelwork, staircases and security doors/grilles. Every project is survey-led: online pages give indicative sizing, style and price; final specification is confirmed after a site survey. No stock gates — everything is made to order.

## Company
- Legal name: Steelyes Ltd
- Workshop: Unit 7, Meridian Industrial Estate, Enfield, London, EN3 7TW, United Kingdom
- Coverage: commissions across the United Kingdom
- Contact: info@steelyes.co.uk / +44 7803 002145

## Gates (by opening mechanism)
- [Gates overview](https://www.steelyes.co.uk/gates): all 8 gate mechanisms compared, choosing swing vs sliding vs folding vs radius
- [Double swing gates](https://www.steelyes.co.uk/gates/double-swing): two-leaf driveway gate, the standard UK driveway gate
- [Single swing gates](https://www.steelyes.co.uk/gates/single-swing): one-leaf pedestrian/side-access gate
- [Tracked sliding gates](https://www.steelyes.co.uk/gates/tracked-sliding): single leaf on a ground track, for sites with side space but no swing clearance
- [Cantilever sliding gates](https://www.steelyes.co.uk/gates/cantilever): slides without a ground track in the opening, needs a counterbalance tail
- [Bifold gates](https://www.steelyes.co.uk/gates/bifold): wide double-leaf fold, short swing footprint
- [Single bifold gates](https://www.steelyes.co.uk/gates/single-bifold): folding single leaf for tight side access
- [Telescopic sliding gates](https://www.steelyes.co.uk/gates/telescopic): multi-panel overlapping slide for wide openings with a short side run
- [Radius sliding gates](https://www.steelyes.co.uk/gates/radius): curved-path sliding gate for non-rectilinear entrances
- [Gate configurator](https://www.steelyes.co.uk/configurator): online tool to design a gate and see an estimated price before survey
